opti.desk: No headset? Use my desk. Play the game, then write 2 sentences for your teacher.

vr.look: A budget is a plan for your money. It splits your income, the money you earn, into saving, spending and giving. A smart budget also saves for an emergency, a surprise you didn't plan for.

models.name: Fruit Basket
models.why: Give: food for a food pantry

steps.title: Get ready
steps.html:
These are the models you will use. In VR, type the gray word in the Models search box to find each one.

@MODELS@

In VR, this page is on the Canvas tab.

steps.title: Go in
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Central in Filter environments. Click Central Bank, then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Build the budget
steps.html: Put the dollar model at the top. Below it, make four piles: 3 coins to save, the ball to spend, the basket to give, and the wheel for emergencies.

steps.title: Take your photo and send it
steps.html:
Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Fit your whole build in the tablet. Click Take photo.

On the Canvas tab, pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 To fix it, send a new photo.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your photo is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? See Having trouble in VR?

extra.html: Make the saving pile the biggest. Leave space between piles so each part is easy to see.

vr.full: One photo that shows the income at the top and all four piles.

studio.title: Who Fixes It?
studio.look: Six problems start on your street. Some go to the city, some to the county, and some to the state in Tallahassee.
studio.do: Read the problem. Tap the government that handles it.

game.miss: Not that one. How many people does this problem touch?
game.done: Six problems sent to the right place! Ask the right level, and problems get fixed faster.
